title_zh: 约定按材料修订虚构冲突地图

scenario.label_zh: 约定按材料修订虚构冲突地图
scenario.goal_zh: 核对港口与武装人员的材料依据，并约定删去未经确认的导弹标记

context_zh: 两位成人学员整理教师提供的虚构冲突报道包，练习地图标注与来源核查。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Jonah
sentences.text: We’ve marked the harbor as a naval base. Does the briefing actually say the navy uses it?

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: Yes, the first paragraph identifies it as the navy’s main base in this fictional country.

sentences.speaker: Jonah
sentences.text: And this person? The caption calls him a militant from the eastern militia, but our key says regular army.

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: That needs changing. The caption identifies his group; it doesn’t make him a member of the national army.

sentences.speaker: Jonah
sentences.text: What about the missile symbol over the warehouse? The witness reports a flash but says she couldn’t identify the weapon.

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: Then we don’t have support for that symbol. I’ll remove it and correct the group label.

sentences.speaker: Jonah
sentences.text: Good. Keep the naval base marker, since that part has a clear source.
